name: Moyer's Fruits and Treasures
description: In Bernville, PA, Moyer's Fruits and Treasures raises Apples, Peaches, Nectarines, Flowers, and Sunflowers on a family-run farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through autumn and summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
